'''Kazac''' was a [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] mercenary and a member of the [[InterStellar Regulators]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Conquest of Makeb]] in [[3638 BBY]] the Regulators sides with the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] in their occupation of the planet. Under orders of [[Vice-Commandant]] [[Grevin]] Kazac and his men held [[Lemda Avesta]] captive in the [[Quake Shelter 14-K]] on the [[Frinn Mesa]]. When a Republic hero and resistance member Prosk arrived to rescue her, Kazac and his men killed Prosk before opening fire on the Republic hero, but were easily defeated.<ref name="Shelter From The Storm" />
